decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the development is used).

Condition : 4 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 5 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the submitted plans for 2.7m wide crossing.
Condition : 6 - The development shall not be occupied until the original wall section has been reinstated except at point of access so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement.
description: Formation of vehicular crossover to existing maisonette.
